subject.title: [Feature Request]: Replace raw textarea with a structured JSON code editor (with folding support)

question: Should OpenClaw accept a bundled CodeMirror-style editor for Control UI raw JSON/JSON5 config editing, and should the existing open PR be repaired or replaced?
rationale: The request fits web frontend ergonomics, but it adds an editor dependency and changes a sensitive config-editing surface where maintainer intent should decide dependency choice and compatibility requirements.

options.title: Sponsor a rebuilt editor PR
options.body: Accept the CodeMirror-style direction only if the implementation is rebuilt on current main, preserves reveal-to-edit and raw save/apply behavior, and includes browser proof.

options.title: Keep the textarea for now
options.body: Decline the dependency and product surface until raw config editing becomes a higher priority or a lighter existing component is chosen.

options.title: Require a short design note
options.body: Keep the issue open while a maintainer note compares dependency choice, JSON5 formatting semantics, sensitive-value handling, and proof requirements before code work continues.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a rebuilt editor PR
recommendation.body: Accept the CodeMirror-style direction only if the implementation is rebuilt on current main, preserves reveal-to-edit and raw save/apply behavior, and includes browser proof.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the current reveal-to-edit flow and is the strongest available routing candidate for the product and compatibility decision.
